title: Notes from the Workshop
subtitle: Fine Gold & Diamond Jewellery
lede: Hallmarked 22K and 18K gold, certified diamonds and bridal heirlooms, made by hand for the families of Thakur Village and beyond.

sections.heading: Our Meaning
sections.content: Mayura is the Sanskrit word for peacock — a creature that has stood for grace, renewal and quiet splendour in Indian art for three thousand years.

owner.name: Darshil Bhandari
owner.message: My family has weighed gold across a counter for three generations. What I wanted for Mayura was simpler than a shop — a room where a mother could bring her daughter, ask every question she liked, and leave holding something she would still be proud of in thirty years. Every piece we sell is hallmarked, every diamond is certified, and every rate is written down before you decide. That is the whole promise.

items.title: Complete transparency
items.copy: Every number that makes up a price is knowable, and we write all of them down before you commit to anything.

items.title: Fair and honest pricing
items.copy: The same rate for everybody, on the board, every morning. Nobody here works on commission.

items.title: Individual attention to every buyer
items.copy: A ₹20,000 pair of studs gets the same tray, the same tea and the same hour as a five-lakh bridal suite.

items.title: An unmatched shopping experience
items.copy: Seventeen people, seating for everyone, and nobody standing over you while you decide.

title: Twenty-two years on one corner of Kandivali
eyebrow: A legacy of trust & brilliance since 2004
subtitle: A legacy of trust & brilliance since 2004
lede: Located in the heart of Kandivali (East), Mumbai, Mayura Jewellers has been a symbol of trust, quality and excellence in jewellery since its inception in 2004. Situated in the vibrant Thakur Village, we have built a reputation for offering timeless treasures and unmatched service for over two decades.

items.title: Lightweight Everyday Jewellery
items.copy: Under twelve grams, secure findings, finishes that survive perfume and a commute.

items.title: Exclusive Bridal Collections
items.copy: Harams, polki chokers and matched suites, planned as a whole trousseau rather than a single piece.

items.title: Italian Imported Jewellery
items.copy: Machine-drawn Italian chain work — the lightest wearable gold made anywhere.

items.title: Natural Gemstones, Certified
items.copy: Rubies, emeralds and sapphires supplied with independent certification, never sold on trust alone.

items.title: Customised & Designer Pieces
items.copy: Bring a photograph, a sketch or a piece to rework. CAD render and quotation within a week.

items.title: Pure Gold Classics
items.copy: 22K in the shapes that have not changed in fifty years, at our lowest making charges.

items.title: Free Gold Testing
items.copy: Bring in any gold, from anywhere. We put it on the XRF analyser and read the purity off the display while you watch. No charge, no obligation, whether or not you bought it here.

items.title: Free Gold Melting
items.copy: Old, broken or unwearable pieces melted down in front of you, weighed before and after, and credited at that day’s rate for the purity read.

items.title: Home Visit Service
items.copy: Across Mumbai, by appointment. A member of our team brings a selection to you, stays with it throughout, and takes it away again if nothing suits.

items.title: Video Consultation
items.copy: Choose up to five designs online and see them live on a video call with a jewellery expert before you visit the store.

items.title: Self-certified hallmarking with our brand logo
items.copy: Every article carries the BIS lozenge, the purity grade and our own maker’s mark — so you can tell at a glance where a piece came from, years later.

items.title: A unique HUID on every piece
items.copy: Six alphanumeric characters, unique to that one article. Verify it yourself on the BIS Care app before you pay. We will hand you your phone and wait.

items.title: Full transparency in purity and pricing
items.copy: Net weight, the day’s rate, making charges and GST — written out on paper and handed over before you decide anything.

items.title: Instagram & Facebook
items.copy: New arrivals, finished commissions and the occasional photograph from the workshop floor.

items.title: WhatsApp
items.copy: The fastest way to reach us. Send a photograph of what you have in mind and we will quote a weight, a price and a date.

items.title: JustDial & local directories
items.copy: Find us, read what customers have written, and get directions to the Rangoli Building.
